items.title: Adobe Firefly adds Build a story and Assemble short video
items.rationale: Two new beta Firefly workspaces take an idea through planned scenes and shots to a finished clip — a shipped tool filmmakers can try today; the section's single Adobe MAX card.
items.excerpt: Adobe Firefly adds two beta workspaces, Build a story and Assemble short video, that take an idea through planned scenes and shots to a finished clip.

items.title: Industry Trio Launch Distinkt, AI-Powered Agency for Global Talent (EXCLUSIVE)
items.rationale: New AI-powered talent agency aimed at unrepresented performers worldwide — a fresh launch reshaping how actors get representation.
items.excerpt: A group of entertainment veterans have launched Distinkt in Los Angeles, a talent agency powered by AI and aimed at the mass population of unrepresented performers worldwide.

items.title: Around 10-15 Percent of SAG-AFTRA Membership Wants AI Blocked, CEO Tells Web Summit
items.rationale: SAG-AFTRA's executive director puts a number on the anti-AI faction (10-15%) and restates the consent-and-compensation route for digital replicas — new data from the union, not a rehash of the amicus brief.
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA national executive director Duncan Crabtree-Ireland told Web Summit in Lisbon that roughly 10-15% of members want the union to block AI outright and are angry it hasn't, as the guild pursues consent-and-compensation rules for digital replicas instead.

items.title: Saranagati Teaser: Hombale Films Backs AI-Driven Film On ISKCON Founder's Life
items.rationale: A major Indian producer ('Kantara') releases the teaser for a hybrid AI feature that uses AI motion capture for its characters, with a worldwide release set for August 2027. The outlet is off-list, but this is a distinct new production.
items.excerpt: 'Kantara' producer Hombale Films unveiled the teaser for Saranagati, a hybrid AI feature using AI motion capture to turn performers into digital characters, set for worldwide release in August 2027.

items.title: KBS 3년만의 대하사극 '문무'…AI 전투신 '고거전' 뛰어넘을까
items.rationale: KBS's 30bn-won flagship historical epic 'Munmu' (premieres Nov. 14) built all three major battle sequences with generative AI video, swapping in newer models during the 18-month shoot. It is a concrete, broadcast-scale production use from a public broadcaster.
items.excerpt: KBS's 30bn-won historical epic 'Munmu' (premieres Nov. 14) built its three big battles — Jupilsan, Maesoseong, Gibeolpo — with generative AI video; CP Lee Ho says AI tools improved so fast over the 18-month production that they kept swapping in newer models, using AI even more for the tidal-flat Gibeolpo battle.
